audience: private medical practices that run their patients and bookings in Semble and want help with the practice side

useCases.title: Review the practice setup
useCases.text: The AI reads your practice: locations, timezone, appointment types and medical specialties, so you can check how Semble is set up.

useCases.title: Check the price list
useCases.text: The AI lists your appointment types, services and stock items with their prices and durations, and looks up one item when you ask.

useCases.title: Look up staff and clinicians
useCases.text: The AI lists the staff users of the practice with their roles and specialties, and gives you the ids other tools need.

useCases.title: Find referrers and payors
useCases.text: The AI searches the contacts of the practice, such as referring doctors and insurers, by name, email, phone or specialty.

useCases.title: Keep admin tasks moving
useCases.text: The AI lists open practice tasks, creates a task for a staff member with a due date and priority, and closes or reassigns tasks.
